hooks.prompt: If this request involves Robot Framework test automation, load the relevant skill's SKILL.md before responding. Available skills: browser, selenium, appium, requests, restinstance (library references); keyword-builder, testcase-builder, resource-architect, libdoc-search, libdoc-explain, results (script-based tools). Available agents: rf-test-architect, rf-debug-expert, rf-keyword-consultant, rf-migration-guide.

If you generated or modified any .robot or .resource files during this session, remind the user to:
1. Run the test suite to verify: `robot --outputdir results tests/`
2. Check results with: `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rf_results.py" --output results/output.xml --sections summary,errors --pretty`
3. Review the generated HTML report at `results/report.html`
